title: Tiny Teamwork: The Last Spark
description: A cooperative pixel platformer for 2-4 players. Share a room code, jump the ruined city streets, activate a relay to open a shared bridge, and get every survivor to shelter before the giant catches up. The biggest challenge was keeping movement, the relay and victory synchronized; the build uses server-owned state and separate-client tests. This entry is one complete level. Next: teammate rescues and more stages.

controls.replay: Host clicks Replay room or presses R after victory
controls.pause: Solo only. Online Esc releases input while the world continues.
